I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-team message to confirm I'd noted it: the 2026 renewal at Marrow Agrisupply is 382 seats.

I couldn't check that number against anything or file it. No Marrow Agrisupply account files show up on the share, and the accounts folder looked empty from where I can see. So for now, his message in #central-team is the only record of the seat count. Nothing else needed doing, since a seat count isn't a finance figure and he asked for no action.
